nativeValidation.reason: The implementation worker has no access to the macOS host. Run the four lifecycle stages and the log controls on m3-16.
nativeValidation.setup: Use bash in a clean checkout of the worker commit. The checkout path and its .t3-tmp directory must fit the native Unix socket bound checked below. The process runtime starts host processes and works with CGO_ENABLED=0. No administrator access, entitlement signing, C toolchain, kernel image or guest disk is required.
commands: for stage in startup running paused delete; do grep -F -- "--- PASS: TestBinaryWithProcessRuntimeDarwin/$stage" ".t3-tmp/darwin-pid-native/lifecycle.log"; done
test "$(grep -Ec 'sandbox [[:xdigit:]-]+ launch log reports guest PID [0-9]+$' ".t3-tmp/darwin-pid-native/lifecycle.log")" -eq 3
test "$(grep -Fc 'guest and supervisor reaped and agent stderr drained before restart' ".t3-tmp/darwin-pid-native/lifecycle.log")" -eq 3

for control in delayed_record split_record delayed_newline unrelated_records_time_out; do grep -F -- "--- PASS: TestWaitForProcessSandboxStarted/$control" ".t3-tmp/darwin-pid-native/log-controls.log"; done
expectedResults: Native vet exits zero. All four lifecycle cases and four log control cases pass without skips.
Startup stops before readiness, opens no readiness socket and produces no early create result.
Running, paused and delete each receive a successful create result and observe one matching launch record for the actual guest marker PID and assigned sandbox.
The existing pause, resume, delete, guest and supervisor reaping, and lost-on-device restart assertions all pass.

The log controls accept a delayed complete record, a split record and a delayed newline only after completion. Unrelated and noninteger records alone reach the deadline and include the expected sandbox, PID and stderr in the error.
